scope: Both Dialogue tables, stages 1-10, after-quest/Garden. No walkthrough text; item upgrade notices separated from NPC text.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Bring the item I gave you to Juliette!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: If you lost the item, we can fix that! Although, you will have to cover my expenses, considering the sentimental value... [CLICK]

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I'm... trying to find gold...

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: but I can only find clay and granite here!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I heard of a gold mine in the Savanna Woodland.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I'd like to craft a gift for my beloved Juliette.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Could you find some gold for me, please?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Thank you so much!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Here, could you do me a favor and bring this gift back to Juliette?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Groceries?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Haha!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I'm here to get a flower bouquet for Juliette.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Could you help out and get some flowers?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I was thinking of a bouquet of roses.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Just one? That's not much of a bouquet!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Going to need a few more than that!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I love roses! Can you get more?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: That's a lot of flowers! Maybe a few more...

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Wow, They're beautiful!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Please bring the bouquet to Juliette!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I love emeralds!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: There's emerald on everything I like!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: This one can't be dislodged!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Could you bring me some emerald?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I'm going to need a full stack of those!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Very cool, but regular emeralds will do the trick.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Although I adore this pristine piece of emerald, I don't need it yet.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I don't need a whole block!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Am

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: -az-

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: -ing!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Now bring this gift to Juliette!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Hey, you again!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I wanted mushrooms to concoct a stew,

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: but these big red ones won't cut it.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I need some decent mushrooms.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I can't cook a gourmet stew with tiny mushrooms!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I need bigger ones!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: That's not the color of mushroom I'm looking for.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Sweet! Just what I need!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: EXCEPT... Could you enchant it?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I need the perfect stew for my beloved Juliette.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: That's a big mushroom that I don't need.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: It's well known that good stews aren't made from brown mushrooms.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I need red mushrooms.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Fantastic!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: There's some stew for Juliette!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Mmh! Tastes great!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: So cold! I wish I had coffee right now...

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I want to reach the moon for Juliette.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Literally!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I wish I could jump like a Rabbit and grab a chunk of it.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: A potion might do the trick, but not quite that one.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Rabbit potion? Sounds great!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Although... could you bring a more potent one?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I don't want to take any chances!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Awesome potion!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Any chance you could have it taste like coffee?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Come back with a caffeinated beverage, thanks!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Thanks!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: See ya later!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Bring the chunk to Juliette!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Hi friend!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I want to make a secret gift for Juliette.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I collected tons of gold...

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Now I just need enough heat to melt it!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: That's not even close to hot!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: *tastes it*

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: This is the kind of lava I need...

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Except I need hotter.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: This is too magical for my taste.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Perfect!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Thank you so much for helping with all my gift ideas.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Can you bring this one to Juliette?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I'm trying to solve this Rubix Prism.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Going to need someone wicked smart to solve it.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: You're pretty smart.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I bet you wish you were smarter, though!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: While very astute.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: you don't have quite what it takes for the Prism!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Can you somehow get even more intelligence?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I can definitely see it, your brain barely fits your head.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Just not quite genius enough to solve the Prism!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: If I was to quantify it, I'd say you need 1,291 Intelligence.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Incredible!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: You solved the Prism!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Please, bring it to Juliette and show her how smart I am.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Juliette keeps talking to me about this other person.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I don't know what's going, they meet over and over!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Our love is stronger than theirs!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I'm waiting for this other person to show up.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I'll need my favorite weapon, can you fetch it for me?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Wow.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: That's not even a weapon!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I do like it though!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: That sword is weak!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Besides, would you really give it to me?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: This is exactly what I need!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Now I just have to wait for the pretendent.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Please bring this poem to Juliette.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I hope she'll see the reason.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: It's you, <player>!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I need your help to win Juliette back.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: My plan is to assemble the greatest bouquet ever!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I need a ridiculous amount of flowers.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: That's exquisite!!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: With this, I can get enough flowers to win Juliette back!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: <Player>! You're the best person to turn the day into something memorable!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: But first, you should wear something nice!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Looking slick!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: You really look stunning!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Thank you so much for reuniting Juliette and I.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Please, one last time, give this to Juliette.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: I love Juliette!

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Fancy seeing you here, friend! Today is a special day for me, as I am seeing Juliette! Think you can help me get her some flowers?

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: You're a lifesaver! Today's going to be the best day ever! Well, after my wedding day, that is.

records.speaker: Romero
records.source: [NPC] Romero: Just because I see Juliette every day doesn't mean it's not a reason to celebrate.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: You found Romero?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Did he have anything for me?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: (Hold Romero's gift to progress)

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Nice to meet you!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Could you find my dear Romero?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: He's in a cave somewhere under the Savanna Woodland.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: ...

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Oh!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: He wears glasses and blends well in a crowd!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: You found Romero? That's weird, I just saw him!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: He wanted me to have this? So sweet!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: A yellow rock? What's the point of that?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Here, you keep it!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Since you're here, can you find Romero again?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: He said he was getting groceries at the downtown markets.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Romero? He just came over with the groceries.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: These flowers are for me?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: That's so kind of you!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: You know I'm with Romero, right?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Dear, sorry for the inconvenience...

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Can you please find Romero again?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: He's at some sort of emerald altar...

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Oof! Why did you bring this all the way here?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: How is that a gift?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Just keep it! I don't want this!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: What I want is Romero!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: For some reason, he's now looking for...

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: The largest, most evil patch of fungus ever!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Stew? I love stew!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: !!!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Yuck!!!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: DISGUSTING!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Is that a stew from hell?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Maybe Romero should give you cooking lessons!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Oh! I love Romero! He has so many skills.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Did you know he likes photography?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Just now, he went to take pictures of the old castle.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Go find him!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: You really believe that this is from the Moon?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: How? Someone flew up there?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Thanks, I guess.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Actually, I heard Romero flew close to the Sun.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Sounds more like a metaphor, like...

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: He went to where gold is smelted.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Please find him, wherever that is!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: This is a wonderful gift!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: I will keep this one for myself.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Sometimes, some things have to remain a mystery.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: About something not so secret, can you get in touch with Romero?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: He told me he's in his home.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Uh? Romero solved his cube?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: That's unbelievable.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: No, really, I don't believe it at all.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: I don't know why Romero is trying to be so unlike himself lately.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: I like him just the way he is!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: He says he's getting equipment for a duel.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Can you find Romero before he hurts himself?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: This is a wonderful poem.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: But, does he really think there's someone else?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: I can't possibly imagine why he'd think that.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Romero went to meditate at his retreat.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: It's the smallest house in SkyBlock.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Please find him, I'm worried!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Another gift from Romero?

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: Thank you for delivering it.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: I don't know how Romero has such hard a time understanding that I LOVE HIM.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: I don't need tons of gifts to know that.

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: It's decided, this is the day!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: We're making it official!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: We can't thank you enough for bringing us together!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: You're the best, <player>!

records.speaker: Juliette
records.source: [NPC] Juliette: I love Romero!
